overview: The login success packet is another near-empty corpus: only Artemis references it, as packet-library plumbing. PacketRepository maps SERVER_LOGIN + 4 to PacketLoginOutSuccess and GPacketLoginServerSuccess wraps the wire format so login traffic is typed. No anticheat reads the UUID or username, because the packet carries only server-asserted identity and arrives before any check-relevant state exists.

checks.name: Login success wrapper (Artemis)
checks.purpose: Wraps PacketLoginOutSuccess so Artemis's packet library can read the login-success UUID and username from the wire.
checks.how_it_works: GPacketLoginServerSuccess is linked to the PacketLoginOutSuccess interface and implements ReadableBuffer. Its read method handles both layouts: pre-1.16 reads a 36-char UUID string plus a 16-char name, and 1.16+ reads four ints that are reassembled into a UUID plus the name. The result is stored as a GameProfile.
checks.detects: None. This is a typed read of server-asserted identity, not a check. No Artemis check subscribes to the packet.
checks.variations: The other 49 anticheats never reference the packet. Its only role in the corpus is keeping Artemis's login-state stream typed.
